semantic_descriptions.first_written_description: I think the rule is to first color in the grey boxes and then, color in the light blue boxes. After that color a square grid around the light blue square, that touches each one of the grey boxes.
semantic_descriptions.last_written_description: I colored the grey boxes first, then I colored the middle light blue square. I then colored a light blue square around the middle light blue square that touched each of the grey squares.
